name: Space
purpose: Inserts a token-sized empty gap on one or both axes without laying out children.
scenarios: Separate a heading from the following paragraph
Add inline breathing room between two controls
Reserve a square gap inside a flex row

size.description: Spacing token applied to the empty slot.

axis.description: Axis that receives the gap. Distinct from stack, which spaces children via flex gap.

variants.name: size
variants.description: Spacing token applied to the empty slot.

states.name: block
states.description: Gap is applied on the block axis.

states.name: inline
states.description: Gap is applied on the inline axis.

states.name: both
states.description: Gap is applied on both axes.

antiPatterns: Do not use Space to wrap children; use Stack when laying out a set of items.
Do not set physical width or height; use size and axis tokens.

a11y.focus: Not focusable; marked aria-hidden because it has no content.
a11y.labeling: Presentational spacer; children and siblings provide names.

responsive.strategy: Token-sized slot only. Breakpoint morph is not applicable; parents choose size.

breakpoints.compact: Same token slot; parent may pass size=sm.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Inline axis follows document direction.
